channel.title: Paksh: Health
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Russian Plague Researcher's Death Raises Questions About Disease
item.description: The death of a worker from a Russian laboratory that researches plague has prompted questions about the disease. The event is being examined for its potential significance regarding the plague. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: WHO: Plague Spread Risk Low Amid Siberian Outbreak
item.description: The World Health Organization (WHO) has stated that the risk of a plague epidemic spreading is very low, following the death of a lab worker in Siberia. The WHO's assessment comes amid reports of other international events, including drone… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Kenya Confirms First Ebola Case After Death in Nairobi
item.description: Kenya has confirmed its first case of Ebola following the death of a man in Nairobi. The victim had reportedly traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Health officials are emphasizing the need for strict infection-control… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Trump to speak with Putin amid Russia plague scare
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump announced he has a call scheduled "very soon" with Russian President Vladimir Putin to discuss a suspected case of pneumonic plague in Siberia. U.S. officials have expressed frustration over a lack of details… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 6 · Right 3.

item.title: CM's angioplasty remarks spark debate on medical procedures
item.description: The Chief Minister of Kerala's comments questioning the necessity of an angioplasty procedure have ignited a debate among medical professionals and the public. The Indian Medical Association (IMA) stated that such remarks could erode… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Florida Dengue Outbreak Becomes Largest in Continental US in Decades
item.description: Florida is experiencing its largest dengue outbreak in the continental United States in decades, with over 250 reported cases. This marks a significant increase in the number of cases in the region. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: New York Declares Measles Disaster Emergency Amid Surge
item.description: New York has declared a state of emergency due to a measles outbreak, marking the first such declaration in the United States since a surge in cases in 2025. The declaration is a response to the escalating number of measles cases. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Ebola Outbreak in DR Congo: Cases Rise, Official Killed
item.description: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 8,000 cases, with a death toll of 3,901. In a related development, mourners buried a DR Congo official who was killed after defending the Ebola response. Thousands of… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 5 · Right 2.

item.title: Global groups declare diabetic foot a world health priority in Bengaluru
item.description: Eight global organizations signed a joint declaration in Bengaluru to make diabetic foot a world health priority. The declaration was made during an event focused on addressing the global health challenge of diabetic foot complications. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: World Heart Day Highlights Need for Young Heart Health
item.description: On World Heart Day, the focus is on the importance of paying attention to the health of young hearts. NMC Healthcare marked the occasion by offering free screenings as part of efforts to promote stronger hearts and healthier lives. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: DR Congo Faces Health Worker Shortage Amid Ebola Surge
item.description: The Democratic Republic of Congo is experiencing a growing shortage of health workers as Ebola cases surge by 73%, according to the World Health Organization (WHO). The outbreak is described as 'out-of-control' by Sky News. The situation… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: PM Modi highlights record Ayushman Bharat medical savings
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that record savings have been achieved on medical expenses under the Ayushman Bharat scheme. The scheme aims to provide health insurance coverage to vulnerable Indians. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Cancer Care Models to be Discussed at 2026 World Cancer Congress
item.description: The National Comprehensive Cancer Network (NCCN) will present models for tailoring cancer care to different regions at the 2026 World Cancer Congress. The focus will be on regional customization of cancer treatment strategies. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.
